MediaX original files below are copied **byte-for-byte** from live commit `08e1b510dfa7396d6b1d05561918db30c604f0c7` (Bot Hosting branch `hosting/bothosting-mediax-ready-20261017`). `src/downloader.js`, `src/youtube-free.js`, `src/youtube-upload.js` and `src/env-number.js` are **unchanged**. The `runner.mjs` wrapper only combines the already existing MediaX YouTube flow (resolveMedia → preferred upload → sendVideo(URL) candidates). `bin/yt-dlp` calls Musix's Python yt-dlp and `ffmpeg-static` resolves to Musix's system FFmpeg; these replace binary dependencies, not algorithms. Never edit MediaX's repo or deployment from Musix.
